mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DATAGEAR_AI_MESSAGE (AM_ID, AM_SESSION_ID, AM_ROLE, AM_CONTENT, AM_CREATE_TIME) VALUES (#{entity.id}, #{entity.sessionId}, #{entity.role}, #{entity.content}, #{entity.createTime})
